title: Introduce query-cost compactor and stability watchdog for alert noise reduction
author: Maya Lin
description: Motivation: our alert plane has been noisy for low-impact query-cost spikes and high-cardinality cost labels are making downstream dashboards expensive to query. This PR introduces two complementary systems: 1) a streaming query-cost compactor that ingests per-invocation token-cost events and emits compact sketches + sparse rollups (cost-skein) suitable for fast dashboards and SLO evaluation; 2) a stability watchdog service that groups short-lived alert bursts into a single incident and applies a configurable quieting window to prevent alert storms. High level changes: added a compactor sidecar (observability/compactor) that performs reservoir sketching and delta coalescing, introduced a lightweight stable-id for invocation groups (invocation-skein) so we can attribute cost across stages without exploding cardinality, updated the dashboard set with a new Cost Skein panel (dashboards/cost-skein.json) and an Alert Stability overview (dashboards/alert-stability.json), and added an ops runbook and rollout plan. Implementation notes: compactor uses a bounded-reservoir + count-min variant to preserve 99th percentile signal while compacting label cardinality, produces two outputs: a compact sketch stream for near-realtime dashboards and an hourly rollup store for long-term SLO backfills. The watchdog subscribes to alert events and coalesces events with the same stable-id within a sliding window; it exposes a REST endpoint to annotate and mute grouped alerts and emits metrics for suppressed_count and grouping_latency. Backwards compatibility: compactor emits both legacy token-cost events and the new compacted stream during the migration window to avoid breaking consumers. Rollout plan: start with a 10% traffic sampling in staging, evaluate dashboard integrity and SLO alignment for 72 hours, then ramp to 50% in prod for 48 hours before full flip. Monitoring and validation: added e2e harness in telemetry/e2e/compactor_test.go that verifies compact->expand fidelity on representative traces and unit tests for grouping heuristics. Migration/rollback: feature flag (telemetry.compactor.enabled) and watchdog on/off flag; rollback is immediate by turning off flags and letting legacy events flow. Docs/runbook: runbooks/alert-watchdog.md and docs/observability/cost-skein.md describe operations and troubleshooting. Related: ENG-2030 (alert noise reduction), SUP-321 (customer incident that motivated grouping).
